videos.script: A support team is asked, sooner or later: how many computers do we have, who has them, and which ones are out of warranty? {{asked}} Without an inventory, the honest answer is nobody knows. With one, it is a search. {{search}} This lesson collects what each computer can say about itself with a short script, and puts three of them into a register. Two things go wrong on the way. {{three}} Then it follows an asset through its life, from the day it arrives to the day its disk is wiped and it leaves. {{life}}
